units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 3a">B. Mets. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 3b:2">3ᵇ</cite> <he>הַעֲדָאַת עדים</he> evidence through witnesses; a. e.

senses.gloss: (יָעַד) warning given to the owner of a mischievous animal (Ex. XXI, 29); law concerning damages payable after warning, v. מוּעָד.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 18b:14">B. Kam. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>יש ה׳ וכ׳</he> the law &c. applies to &c. (and full damages must be paid). Y. ib. II, beg. 2ᵈ; a. fr.
